basics.name: Dmitry Ivanov
basics.label: Software Engineer
basics.summary: Software engineer focused on high-performance web applications, real-time audio, and 2D/3D graphics. Built fintech products at Mobeewave, Apple, and Brainfinance, voice interfaces at ElevenLabs, and scientific visualization at Plotly. Current open-source work covers WebAssembly, DSP, color, and UI tooling.

work.name: Independent Open Source
work.summary: Career break for long-planned open-source projects, including AudioJS and ColorJS. Selected projects total 3,000+ GitHub stars.

work.name: Brainfinance
work.summary: Consumer fintech serving 100,000+ users in Canada: icash.ca loans and earna.zone savings.
highlights: Owned frontend architecture and delivery for earna.zone, including its landing page, dashboard, application flows, and shadcn/Tailwind/Storybook design system
Rebuilt the icash.ca frontend, including loan application and contract-signing flows; contract drop-off fell 40% in an A/B test
Raised key icash.ca flows above 95 in PageSpeed performance tests and addressed WCAG AA accessibility issues

work.name: ElevenLabs
highlights: Designed and launched elevenlabs.io with 11ty, Firebase authentication, Stripe payments, and voice API access
Built the browser player for generated speech

work.name: Mobeewave / Apple
work.summary: Joined Mobeewave in 2019 and continued at Apple after the 2020 acquisition.
highlights: Mobeewave: built the frontend for Samsung POS, a PCI DSS-compliant tap-to-pay product shipped in Samsung Wallet
Mobeewave: built acquirer, admin, and provisioning portals; the acquirer portal was used by 50+ financial institutions
Created Spect, a frontend framework for state and component composition
Apple: built the Wallet web push provisioning flow and Apple Business Registry portal frontend
Apple: built the Pay Later checkout widget with real-time calculations
Built the reference polyfill for the W3C Template Instantiation proposal

work.name: Plotly
work.summary: Built and maintained the WebGL stack for plotly.js, an open-source scientific charting library.
highlights: Built WebGL scatter, line, scatterplot-matrix, and waveform renderers
Designed point clustering for real-time exploration of datasets up to 1 billion points
Maintained regl and 24 gl-vis repositories, including 2D and 3D renderers
Built visual-regression tooling covering 2,000+ chart variants

work.name: TTBA Group
work.summary: Built 10+ sites at 100/100 PageSpeed; Wishbox.gift used Preact and API integration.

work.name: KudaGo
work.summary: Built KudaGo for 15+ cities; its mobile site used under 20 KB of JavaScript and scored 100/100 PageSpeed at launch.

work.name: Freelance
work.summary: Part-time web, UI, and graphic design; built an interactive VoiceKey guide during a 2012 Speech Technology Center internship.

education.area: BSc: Information & Computer Science; MSc: Computer Graphics & Intelligent Systems

education.institution: Saint Petersburg College of Marine Instrumentation

projects.name: AudioJS
projects.description: Creator and maintainer of 70+ public audio and DSP repositories for browsers and Node.
highlights: audio: streaming decode, page-cached 10 GB+ files, non-destructive edits, and on-demand codecs
web-audio-api: portable Web Audio API implementation; 950+ GitHub stars
wavearea: multiline playback and editing
JZ-based WebAssembly compilation for DSP modules
300+ audio-processing modules spanning analysis, filtering, effects, synthesis, and neural audio

projects.name: JZ / watr
projects.description: Created JZ, a numeric JavaScript-to-WebAssembly compiler for DSP, graphics, and codecs, and watr, a WAT compiler and optimizer.

projects.name: sprae
projects.description: Created signals-based DOM microhydration for server-rendered and static pages, with no build step or virtual DOM.

projects.name: Wavefont / Linefont
projects.description: Created OpenType fonts that render waveform and line-chart data as text; 900+ GitHub stars combined.

projects.name: color-space / glsl-transpiler
projects.description: Creator and maintainer of color-space, a color conversion library, and glsl-transpiler, a GLSL-to-JavaScript compiler for CPU execution.
